summary: Intellia Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to announce positive Phase 3 trial results for lonvoguran ziclumeran in hereditary angioedema, not a special situation. The release details topline efficacy and safety data from the HAELO trial, including an 87% reduction in attack rate. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. The filing is purely a clinical data update and routine disclosure of material non-public information. No deal terms are applicable.
